result.title: QuadBrain Ollama endpoint integration tests
result.notes: Recorded 2026-10-15: the four tests and OllamaServerController cite this id, which the store never held (operator decision "Approve all three (Recommended)"; PLAN-SESSIONTRIAGEFIX-001 B13, triage-report-680916ed).

acceptanceCriteria.text: ChatCompletions_LocalOllamaDefaultModel_TriggersNormalBrainSlots (prompts "Hello" and "Create Hello World in C++"): with the local Ollama default model assigned to all four slots, each prompt triggers the normal Creativity, Logic and Arbiter workflow through POST /v1/chat/completions and returns non-empty content; every brain call uses that model at the Ollama endpoint, and the session log captures the brain outputs on the turn.

QBAgentRunLoop_LocalOllamaDefaultModel_DisplaysQuadBrainResponse (prompt "Hello"): QBAgent displays the QuadBrain response it received, never a placeholder; its transcript names the model QuadBrain and the QBrainAi endpoint and never the Ollama model id or endpoint.
ChatCompletions_OpenAiCompatibleFieldVariants_AreLoggedToSessionTurn: content, reasoning and reasoning_content outputs are persisted to the turn's processing dialog.

The class runs against a real local Ollama: OllamaServerFixture adopts a server already answering or starts one from a discovered executable and stops only what it started (FR-MCP-QBOLLAMA-002); on LAB-OMARCHY the executable is the one InstallOllama provisions (TR-MCP-NUKE-016; PLAN-SESSIONTRIAGEFIX-001 B13, triage-report-680916ed).

result.description: QuadBrainOllamaEndpointIntegrationTests exercise the OpenAI-compatible QuadBrain endpoint against a real local Ollama server that OllamaServerFixture adopts or starts (FR-MCP-QBOLLAMA-002), proving FR-MCP-QBOPENAI-001 runs the normal Creativity, Logic and Arbiter workflow without faking the LLM calls, on Windows and on Linux once InstallOllama has provisioned Ollama (TR-MCP-NUKE-016).
